subject_description: a small dark-slate and cold mint necrotic ground fire patch with three narrow separate upward flame tongues, coarse pixel art on transparency
initial_pose: three thin mint ground flames rooted at fixed contact x60 y116, fully burning
description: The ground flame dies down in place. The three narrow mint tongues become shorter and thinner, curl and sink toward the fixed floor contact at x60 y116; a few small mint tips detach and vanish. Fade completely to transparent empty canvas. Keep the same muted colors and sparse negative space. No shrinking orb, no circular ring, no flash, no large smoky cloud, no explosion and no camera movement. A quiet end to ground fire.
